== Biography ==
Thomas Glasgow was born on 5 November 1725 and baptised two days later at Kilwinning, Ayrshire. The held register derivative names his parents [[Glasgow-1056|Hugh Glasgow]] and [[Kilpatrick-1635|Janet Kilpatrick]], with family residence Byres, Kilwinning.<ref name="Birth1725">Findmypast, ''Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929'', birth 5 November 1725, baptism 7 November, Kilwinning, residence Byres, Hugh Glasgow and Janet Kilpatrick, OPR 599/1 item 1 page 197; [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3626888&tab=this SCOT/OPR/BAP/3626888], accessed 4 September 2026; held derivative, original uninspected.</ref> Parish and residence do not independently establish the exact birthplace.

Thomas married [[Mill-357|Janet Isobel Mill]] in 1742.<ref>“Scotland Marriages, 1561–1910,” FamilySearch, [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XY96-5ZV Thomas Glasgow, marriage in 1742], accessed 22 December 2023.</ref> The maintained family contains seven known children recorded between 1743 and 1757, principally at Livingston. [[Glasgow-1382|Their son Thomas]] was baptised at Davistoun on 2 February 1746 to Thomas Glasgow and Janet Mill; he is now confidently identified, by the combined later family evidence, with Christian Davidson's husband.<ref name="Child1746">[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4151556&tab=this SCOT/OPR/BAP/4151556], Thomas Glasgow, Livingston, Davistoun, baptism 2 February 1746, parents Thomas Glasgow and Janet Mill, OPR 669/1 item 4; held derivative, original uninspected.</ref> [[Glasgow-2980|John Glasgow]] was recorded at Mid Calder in 1750, with Janet Mill named as mother.<ref>“Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950,” FamilySearch, [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1BL-JX1 John Glasgow], accessed 12 February 2020.</ref> [[Glasgow-1385|William Glasgow]] was baptised 26 June 1757 at Livingston to Thomas Glasgow and Janet Mill.<ref name="William1757">[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_685841157&tab=this R_685841157] and [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_692406065&tab=this R_692406065], held derivative transcripts; baptism 26 June 1757, Livingston, Thomas Glasgow and Janet Mill, no explicit birthday; original uninspected.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Scope of Thomas's own parentage ===
The recorded 1725 child's father Hugh remains assessed at 98%; maternal identity is not newly assessed. The exact event, locality and complete parental couple match the maintained Kilwinning account. This does not independently prove every later Mid Calder identity or Hugh's own father. The existing ScotlandsPeople and Findmypast citations use different finding-aid locators for the Kilwinning entry, retained for original-register comparison. Birth 5 November and baptism 7 November are separate events, not rival dates or parents. The later William father assessment stays 80%, with his maternal and adult-identity limits unchanged.

=== Son Thomas and the Livingston family ===
The 1746 entry's explicit recorded-child father clause retains its narrower 98% assessment. The complete identification of Christian Davidson's adult husband as this son was assessed 78% probable on 23 October and is now 93% confident inference. The old 78% is preserved as history; it is not a rival current grade. No mother is replaced or inferred from the older generation: Janet Mill is this child's mother, while Janet Kilpatrick is his grandmother.

The preferred later Thomas death year 1831, age 85, places birth approximately in 1745–1746, fitting the Davistoun baptism and the same parish. The alternative 1851/85-derived birth about 1766 would make the adult father only about seven or eight at Nathaniel's 1774 baptism. The full Thomas/Christian Davidson memorial family and parish children support the earlier identity together, not through independent votes from companion indexes. The competing May/July month and 1851 reading remain explicit. The younger Thomas's birth remains bounded before 2 February 1746; no exact birthday follows.

Other childhood comparisons, Thomas-1413 born 1744 at Irvine to Michael/Mary Crauford and Thomas-4109 born 1749 at Edinburgh to John/Eliz Morison, remain unexcluded but fit age and parish continuity less well. This review leaves this father's own birth, ancestors, wife, other children and their existing grades unchanged. Catharine's 1780 source still names the adult Thomas and Christian Davidson and belongs to the son's family, not this older man's wife.<ref>[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4152175&tab=this SCOT/OPR/BAP/4152175], Catharine, born 20 August, baptised 31 August 1780 at Blackburne, Livingston, Thomas Glasgow and Christian Davidson; held derivative, original uninspected.</ref>

[https://glasgow.phenotype.dev/people/glasgow-1382.html#research-findings The son's full family argument] retains the actual memorial variants and remaining adult-identity alternatives. No new source fetch, original reading, attachment or live WikiTree save is claimed; the original registers and legible inscription remain useful targeted tests.
